name: dateAdd
description: Adds units of time to a date object.
syntax: dateAdd( string datePart, number number, datetime date )

params.name: datePart
params.description:
One of the following units:

- yyyy: Year
- q: Quarter
- m: Month
- y: Day of year
- d: Day
- w: Weekday
- ww: Week
- h: Hour
- n: Minute
- s: Second
- l: Millisecond

params.name: number
params.description: Number of units of datepart to add to date (positive, to get dates in the future; negative, to get dates in the past). Number must be an integer.
